## API Endpoint: Token Generation

This endpoint is used to obtain an access token for authentication purposes. It accepts a `grant_type` parameter and returns a JSON object containing the access token and related information.

**Test credentials**

Username:Test

Password:1234

### Request

- **Method**: POST
    
- **URL**: `http://api2.shipuniversal.com/token`
    
- **Content-Type**: `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
    

#### Request Body Parameters

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| grant_type | text | The type of grant being requested. |

### Sample Request

``` plaintext
grant_type=client_credentials

 ```

### Response

- **Status Code**: 200
    
- **Content-Type**: `application/json`
    

#### Response Body

The response will contain the following fields:

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| access_token | string | The token used for authentication. |
| token_type | string | The type of the token (e.g., Bearer). |
| expires_in | integer | The duration in seconds until the token expires. |
| refresh_token | string | Token used to obtain a new access token. |
| issued | string | The timestamp when the token was issued. |
| expires | string | The timestamp when the token will expire. |

### Sample Response

``` json
{
  "access_token": "your_access_token_value",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 3600,
  "refresh_token": "your_refresh_token_value",
  "issued": "2023-10-01T12:00:00Z",
  "expires": "2023-10-01T13:00:00Z"
}

 ```

This sample response illustrates the expected format and data types of the response body, helping users understand what to expect when they make this request.

This endpoint is used to obtain an access token for authentication purposes. It is typically utilized in scenarios where secure access to protected resources is required. The token generated can be used in subsequent API calls to authenticate the user

#### Response Structure

The response will return a JSON object containing the following fields:

- **access_token**: A string representing the token that can be used for authentication.
    
- **token_type**: A string indicating the type of token returned (e.g., Bearer).
    
- **expires_in**: An integer representing the lifetime in seconds of the access token.
    
- **refresh_token**: A string that can be used to obtain a new access token when the current one expires.
    
- **.issued**: A timestamp indicating when the token was issued.
    
- **.expires**: A timestamp indicating when the token will expire.
    

### Usage Notes

- Ensure that the `grant_type` parameter is included in the request body as it is essential for token generation.
    
- Upon a successful request, the response will include the access token and other related information, which should be securely stored for future use.

## Create Shipment API

This endpoint allows users to create a shipment by providing necessary details about the sender, receiver, service details, package details, and additional information related to the shipment.

### Request Format

The request must be sent as a JSON object in the body of the POST request. The structure of the request body is as follows:

| Parameter Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AccountCode | string | Yes | Unique code for the account making the shipment. |
| Sender | object | Yes | Details of the sender. |
| SenderName | string | Yes | Name of the sender. |
| SenderContactPerson | string | Yes | Contact person for the sender. |
| SenderAddressLine1 | string | Yes | First line of sender's address. |
| SenderAddressLine2 | string | No | Second line of sender's address. |
| SenderAddressLine3 | string | No | Third line of sender's address. |
| SenderPincode | string | Yes | Pincode for sender's address. |
| SenderCity | string | Yes | City of the sender. |
| SenderState | string | Yes | State of the sender. |
| SenderTelephone | string | Yes | Telephone number of the sender. |
| SenderEmailId | string | Yes | Email ID of the sender. |
| KYCType | string | Yes | Type of KYC document provided by the sender. |
| KYCNo | string | Yes | KYC number of the sender. |
| Receiver | object | Yes | Details of the receiver. |
| ReceiverName | string | Yes | Name of the receiver. |
| ReceiverContactPerson | string | Yes | Contact person for the receiver. |

| ReceiverCountry | string | Yes | Country of the receiver. |
| ReceiverTelephone | string | Yes | Telephone number of the receiver. |
| ReceiverEmailid | string | Yes | Email ID of the receiver. |
| VatId | string | Yes | VAT ID of the receiver. |
| ServiceDetails | object | Yes | Details of the service selected for shipment. |
| Service | string | Yes | Type of service for the shipment. |
| GoodsType | string | Yes | Type of goods being shipped. |
| PackageType | string | Yes | Type of package used for shipment. |
| PackageDetails | object | Yes | Details of the package. |
| PackageDetail | array | Yes | List of package details. |
| Length | number | Yes | Length of the package. |

| Description | string | Yes | Description of the product. |
| HSNCode | string | Yes | HSN code for the product. |
| UnitType | string | Yes | Type of unit for the product. |
| Qty | number | Yes | Quantity of the product. |
| UnitRate | number | Yes | Rate per unit of the product. |
| ShipPieceIGST | number | Yes | IGST applicable per piece. |
| PieceWt | number | Yes | Weight of each piece. |
| InvoiceCurrency | string | Yes | Currency for the invoice. |
| InvoiceNo | string | Yes | Invoice number for the shipment. |
| InvoiceDate | string | Yes | Date of the invoice. |
| TermsOfSale | string | Yes | Terms of sale for the shipment. |
| ReasonForExport | string | Yes | Reason for exporting the goods. |
| FreightCharge | number | Yes | Freight charges for the shipment. |
| InsuranceCharge | number | Yes | Insurance charges for the shipment. |
| CSB_Type | string | Yes | Type of CSB applicable. |
| CustomerRefNo | string | Yes | Customer reference number. |
| DeliveryConfirmation | string | Yes | Method of delivery confirmation. |
| DutyTax | string | Yes | Duty tax applicable for the shipment. |
| DutiesAccountNo | string | Yes | Duties account number. |
| TransactionId | string | Yes | Unique transaction ID for the shipment. |
| ShipperImage | string | Yes | Base64 encoded image of the shipper. |
| ShipperKYC | string | Yes | Base64 encoded KYC document of the shipper. |
| FileName | string | Yes | Name of the KYC document file. |

### Response Fields

| Parameter Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Status | boolean | Yes | Indicates whether the shipment creation was successful. |
| Error | string | No | Contains error details, if any. |
| Data | object | Yes | Contains shipment-related information. |
| └── AwbNo | string | No | Air Waybill Number. |
| └── Destination | string | No | The destination of the shipment. |
| └── ChargeableWeight | string | No | The weight used for billing. |
| └── TotalCharges | string | No | Total charges for the shipment. |
| └── AdditionalCharges | array | No | List of any additional charges incurred. |
| └── └── Description | string | No | Description of the additional charge. |
| └── └── Amount | number | No | Amount of the additional charge. |
| └── TrackingNumbers | array | No | Contains tracking information for the shipment. |
| └── └── TrackingNo | string | No | Tracking number for the shipment. |
| └── └── LabelUrl | string | No | URL for the shipment label. |
| └── └── InvoiceUrl | string | No | URL for the shipment invoice. |
| Timestamp | string | No | The time at which the response was generated. |
